findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be testing at 0 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer solution was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitizer solution is available at the proper concentration during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS items to be kept past 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper date marking and items were discarded. Ensure any TCS item kept longer than 24 hours is properly date marked and discarded after 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed a bottle of bleach to be on the same shelf as in use dressing. Discussed with PIC, bleach was moved to a location away from dressing. Ensure any toxic material is stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
3-302.12: Observed a white powder container on the frontline to be unlabeled (suspected to be sugar). Please label all white powders and clear liquids with common name. 

 If in working container, FOOD not readily recognized or easily mistakable shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19:  Observed the leg of the microwave in the drive-thru area to be repaired using a folded piece of cardboard. Cease use of cardboard as a construction material. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Observed the following areas to need cleaning attention: 1) the ceiling of the walk-in cooler is soiled with dust; and 2) the wall around the upright mixer is soiled with dust hanging from storage racks and walls. Clean the ceiling and walls. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed a food handler to wash hands appropriately, dry hands with paper towels, and then turn off the faucet handles with no barrier such as a paper towel (cross contamination). Discussed with employee. Inspector asked employee to properly re-wash their hands. Utilize a barrier such as a paper towel to turn off faucet handles after adequately washing hands. Ensure staff is aware of proper hand washing techniques. Discussed with PIC who was with Inspector throughout the inspection. COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

Observed the sani bucket in the kitchen to be low - 10 ppm. Discussed with PIC. PIC had an employee re-make the sani bucket. Bucket concentration of bleach was likely low due to being after lunch hour. Discussed changing buckets out after lunch in order to maintain appropriate concentration of bleach - 50 to 200 ppm. Facility has test strips to check concentrations. Bleach bucket re-tested at 200 ppm. COS. Ensure staff is aware to frequently change sani buckets to maintain concentration limits.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Observed the following areas to be in need of cleaning:
1. The hood system is heavily stained black and has residue on the baffles above the main pizza oven area. Per the sticker on the hood system, Rock Solid services the facility 2x yearly. Last cleaning service was March 2023. Ensure services comes as needed to maintain the area. PIC indicated Rock Solid cleans the entire hood area and staff cleans behind the equipment and the walls during the bi-annual cleaning services.
2. The reach-in cooler across from the main kitchen prep area (with the ovens) has dust on the interior fan grates. Ensure staff routinely cleans the interior fans of the coolers. The other reach-in cooler (near the reach-in freezers by the pizza prep area) had only a minor amount of dust. PIC was in compliance to clean and maintain cleaning of the interior fans grates.
3. The area with the pizza box/tray shelving (above the pizza dough prep area) has quite a bit of flour/dust on the shelving grates. The rolling shelving cart with the flour in this area has flour and dust on it as well. The ceiling tiles/vent directly above this area (in front of the walk-in cooler) has flour/dust. The area is heavily affected by the amount of dust during the dough making process. Ensure the area is cleaned as needed to keep shelving units, roller carts, and the ceilings clean. PIC was in compliance.
4. Both squeezers of the dish machine and 3 compartment sink areas have grime/debris on the handles and on/under the spray squeezer. Discussed routinely using stainless steel wool to scrub the scum off. Ensure dish washing staff is aware.

Discussed routine cleaning of the above areas with PIC. Ensure staff is aware. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs (to be smooth, easily cleanable, non-absorbent):
1. The hand sink in the main kitchen needs re-caulked to the wall. The interior creases of the hand sink have moldy caulking. Creases need re-caulked.
2. Mop sink needs re-caulked due to significantly moldy caulking around the basin.
3. Three compartment sink needs re-caulked to the wall due to moldy caulking.
4. The dish machine area needs caulked to the wall. There is a visible gap between the wall and the dish machine equipment. Caulk the dish machine equipment to the wall.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs before the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.17: (A) Attachments to walls and ceilings (i.e. light fixtures, fans, decorative items) shall be EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Wall and ceiling surfaces in CONSUMER area need not meet requirement if kept clean. 

1) The hand sink in the dish area has a gap between it and the wall; 2) the corner coving next to the hand sink in the dish area has a gap where it it pulling away from the wall; 3) the hand sink in the dough prep area is pulling away from the wall; 4) the caulking along the inside of the hand sink in the dough area is black and partially broken off. PIC is instructed to seal/ caulk these areas (remove/replace in relation to item 4) prior to the next routine inspection. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

Shelves in multiple areas are in need of cleaning: 1) dish area (dust); 2) rolling shelves next to the standing freezer (food debris); 3) dough prep area (flour/dust); 4) walk in cooler (dust/flour). The vent above the pizza prep area has an accumulation of dust/flour on it and on the ceiling tiles around it. PIC is instructed to clean the facility sufficiently regularly to maintain clean.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands, then turn off the faucet and with the same paper towel used for drying their hands. Inspector discussed with the PIC and instructed to review hand washing procedures with employees to ensure safe hand washing practices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

1) The roof of the microwave next to the cheese sauce dispensers is observed soiled with food debris. PIC cleaned during the inspection to correct. PIC is instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation. 2) The surface of the Cayenne hot holding machine currently holding marinara sauce is observed with marinara splash on the outside that has dried. An employee cleaned during the inspection to correct. PIC is instructed to clean often enough so as to maintain clean. 3) The surface of the coffee maker is observed with a thick accumulation of used coffee grinds. PIC cleaned during the inspection to correct. PIC is instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11  (C) Clean utensils and single-service articles shall be handled, displayed and dispensed so that food- and lip-contact surfaces are protected form contamination. The container storing pizza spatula above the slicing counter has debris in the container that is contacting the spatula. The container and utensils were moved to the dish area to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 (A & B) (C) Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Except for cleaning up a spill or other accident, cleaning should be done during periods when the least amount of food is exposed such as after closing. 1) Shelves are observed with accumulated dust above the three part sink, above the dough mixer are, above the pizza boxes and on the miscellaneous shelf at the end of the island by the office. 2) The floor around the dough mixer is heavily soiled. PIC is instructed to clean these areas often enough so as to maintain the clean.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12  (C) A soufflé cup was observed in a container of grated parmesan cheese. Anything used as a utensil for ready-to-eat foods should have a handle that allows for contact with between the hand and RTE food to be removed.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11  (C) Clean containers used for grated parmesan cheese service are stored in a container that has debris in the bottom. Cleaned and sanitized food contact items should be stored in such a way so as to be protected from contamination prior to use/service.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1. Containers of bulk powders needs to be kept clean. 2. Shelves in the walk in cooler. 3. Shelves were the liquid butter sits.  Clean the non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed no hot water at the employee handsink in the kitchen.  Manager stated that something was replaced recently.  Facility was able to correct the violation during the inspection and now has hot water at each hand washing facility.
750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Observed a minimal amount of fruit flies near the mop sink.  Continue pest control for the establishment.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1. (REPEATx2)  Wall in the pizza prep area has food splash.  Clean the wall. 2. (REPEAT) Observed holes in the wall above mopsink.  Caulk or seal the holes to make them smooth. 3.Wall underneath the three compartment sink is soiled. 4. Table to the left of the dish machine is coming apart from the wall.  Re-caulk this wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
